headline: Fishermans Row Boils Anew; Dead Lands and Lykos Isle Stir
war_summary: Since our last edition the base war has quickened. Fishermans Row stands busiest of all fields — thirty-eight actions in the day, ten in the past two hours, the newest logged forty-five minutes before press, with Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing the day's pivots — its works holding at eight Warden to one Colonial. The Dead Lands, after the night's passage of The Salt March into Warden keeping, stirred again within the hour, two fresh actions on the books and the field divided six Colonial to five Warden. Lykos Isle filed the war's newest action, scarce half an hour before this edition, the fourteenth of its day, with one work left in ruin. The Weathered Expanse packed all nine of the day's actions into six hours, its newest past five o'clock, though the casualty flood there cools — above twenty thousand Colonial and nearly twenty-four thousand Warden losses in the day. Farranac Coast has shifted no work since four o'clock, yet bleeds faster, past four hundred an hour apiece. Stlican Shelf, Warden save one work, grapples on at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. The ledger reads two hundred forty-seven Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, one work to the Colonial good since our last accounting. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-second day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
